verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only developer building blocks: nodes, a launch system for coordinating multiple nodes, managed lifecycles, and long-running actions. The background daemon it mentions only caches ROS graph information to speed up CLI queries. None of this is a documented, user-facing way to define automations (triggers, schedules, recurring jobs) that run autonomously in the background, so the applicable axis earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
